cd /tmp && rm -f t2.grib2* && curl -s -o t2.grib2.bz2 'https://opendata.dwd.de/weather/nwp/icon-eu/grib/00/pmsl/icon-eu_europe_regular-lat-lon_single-level_2026092300_007_PMSL.grib2.bz2' && ls -la t2.grib2.bz2 && file t2.grib2.bz2 && bunzip2 -f t2.grib2.bz2 && python3 -c "import eccodes
f=open('/tmp/t2.grib2','rb')
gid=eccodes.codes_grib_new_from_file(f)

print('shortName', eccodes.codes_get(gid,'shortName'))
print('units', eccodes.codes_get(gid,'units'))
print('Ni', eccodes.codes_get(gid,'Ni'))
print('Nj', eccodes.codes_get(gid,'Nj'))
print('validityDate', eccodes.codes_get(gid,'validityDate'))
print('validityTime', eccodes.codes_get(gid,'validityTime'))
print('iDirectionIncrementInDegrees', eccodes.codes_get(gid,'iDirectionIncrementInDegrees'))
res = eccodes.codes_grib_get_data(gid)
print('codes_grib_get_data returns tuple of len', len(res))
for i,item in enumerate(res):
    try:
        print(i, type(item), len(item))
    except Exception as e:
        print(i, type(item), 'no len', e)
